verdict.rationale: Pilot is a done-for-you bookkeeping/accounting service, so ledger customization is a fair question, but the evidence pack only mentions generic 'custom workflows and reporting' with no mention of chart of accounts structure, account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions. Missing for 10: any documentation of COA setup, account type hierarchy, sub-account creation, or class/tag dimension tagging controlled by the accountant.
